items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: In a bowling alley, setting up pins. Grody's (phonetic spelling) Bowling Alley... That's how we came about.

ctx.x: How did you happen to bump into him?

In a bowling alley, setting up pins. Grody's (phonetic spelling) Bowling Alley, setting up pins, pin boys. Different leagues played bowl, you know. That's how we came about. We started to entertain the soldiers.
